methodology.coverage: Established G0 passage-specific, synthesis-usable, multi-dimension methodology; raw counts are not quality.

Genesis 19: attempted sexual assault and disputed alternative

claim_dispositions.claim: Three Genesis 18 visitors explicitly mean the Trinity in immediate grammar.
claim_dispositions.reason: The narrative shifts among men, YHWH, and visitors; Trinitarian readings are later Christian reception.

claim_dispositions.claim: Genesis 19 is exclusively one modern political or sexual slogan.
claim_dispositions.reason: Sexual assault, domination, hospitality violation, and wider injustice remain in the scene; exclusive reduction is unsupported.

claim_dispositions.claim: The demand to “know” the visitors has no sexual dimension.
claim_dispositions.reason: The narrative context describes attempted gang assault; a minority legal proposal is recorded as disputed without erasing the threat.

claim_dispositions.claim: Lot’s offer of his daughters is morally approved hospitality.
claim_dispositions.reason: The text reports the disturbing offer without morally approving it.

claim_dispositions.claim: A specific excavated site is definitely biblical Sodom or Gomorrah.
claim_dispositions.reason: Site proposals remain disputed; no destruction layer proves the narrative identification.

claim_dispositions.claim: Sulfur balls or one destruction layer prove Genesis 19.
claim_dispositions.reason: Material claims do not establish the narrative identification; the Tall el-Hammam airburst paper was retracted in 2025.

claim_dispositions.claim: Lot’s wife became salt through a known geological mechanism.
claim_dispositions.reason: Genesis supplies no geological mechanism.

claim_dispositions.claim: Moabite and Ammonite ancestry permits ethnic contempt.
claim_dispositions.reason: Etiological narrative does not warrant ethnic stereotyping.

claim_dispositions.claim: Genesis 20 forces later prophetic office structures onto Abraham.
claim_dispositions.reason: Navi and intercession are explicit, but later institutions are not projected backward unchanged.

claim_dispositions.claim: Household infertility in Genesis 20 has a recoverable medical cause.
claim_dispositions.reason: The narrative makes a theological claim without medical reconstruction.

claim_dispositions.claim: Ancient legal parallels fully explain or justify Hagar and Ishmael’s expulsion.
claim_dispositions.reason: Comparisons are bounded; distress and expulsion remain visible.

claim_dispositions.claim: Ishmael’s nation promise licenses ethnic stereotyping.
claim_dispositions.reason: The promise is affirmative and does not justify caricature.

claim_dispositions.claim: Genesis 22 endorses human sacrifice.
claim_dispositions.reason: The test is stopped and a ram is offered instead of Isaac.

claim_dispositions.claim: Genesis 22 is simply borrowed from one pagan ritual.
claim_dispositions.reason: No single origin theory is established by comparative evidence.

claim_dispositions.claim: Moriah is an exact modern Temple Mount coordinate in Genesis 22.
claim_dispositions.reason: 2 Chronicles 3:1 supplies a later Jerusalem association, not an applicability anchor or precise coordinate.

claim_dispositions.claim: Later Akedah or Christian typology is the sole immediate meaning of Genesis 22.
claim_dispositions.reason: Reception history is distinct from the immediate command, test, intervention, and ram.

claim_dispositions.claim: The Genesis 24 oath-under-thigh gesture certainly has a sexual ritual meaning.
claim_dispositions.reason: The narrator does not explain the gesture; interpretations remain debated.

claim_dispositions.claim: The Hittite imperial code directly governs Genesis 23.
claim_dispositions.reason: The ethnonym does not establish imperial legal jurisdiction.

claim_dispositions.claim: Rebekah had no agency in Genesis 24.
claim_dispositions.reason: The text records her answer, “I will go.”

claim_dispositions.claim: Every Genesis 25 descendant is securely identified with a later people.
claim_dispositions.reason: Genealogical and geographic identifications vary in confidence.

claim_dispositions.claim: Birthright means only a double inheritance portion.
claim_dispositions.reason: The narrative also concerns household status, kinship, inheritance, oath, and narrator evaluation.
